rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-031 if p_window_days is NULL or outside 1-90; no default applied.
rules.notes: numeric parameter checked before any loan processing

rules.title: Skip NPA classification
rules.statement: Skip loan and increment p_skipped when asset_class = 'NPA'; no further processing for that loan.

rules.title: Missing benchmark error
rules.statement: Raise exception LMS-005 if benchmark_code IS NULL on a floating-rate loan.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Compute v_months as complete reset cycles since disb_date then add one reset_months interval to obtain v_next; uses extract(year/month from age) with integer division, no rounding function.
rules.notes: declared as int for v_months; date arithmetic only

rules.title: Notice date weekend adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday or 1 day if Sunday; no holiday table consulted.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new = latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= v_next plus spread_pct; coalesce each part to 0 when no row or spread is null; numeric type with no declared precision.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old = latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= (disb_date + (v_months - reset_months) months) plus spread_pct; coalesce each part to 0; numeric type with no declared precision.

rules.title: Minimum rate change threshold
rules.statement: Skip and increment p_skipped when abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25; comparison uses raw numeric subtraction.
rules.notes: 0.25 is literal, not a declared constant

rules.title: Duplicate notice suppression
rules.statement: Skip if a RESET_NOTICE row already exists with note matching 'reset ' || v_next || '%'; checked via EXISTS on loan_ledger.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert into loan_ledger with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new (numeric), entry_date = v_notice, note containing v_next, v_old and v_new; increment p_posted.
rules.notes: amount column receives the new rate value

open_questions: Is the weekend-only adjustment for v_notice (no holiday calendar) the intended behaviour?
Should missing benchmark rates default to 0 or raise an error instead?
Is the duplicate check on the free-text note column reliable for preventing duplicate notices?
